verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Firecrawl does LLM-based structured extraction. However, nothing in the evidence documents configuring a local or self-hosted LLM (for example Ollama or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint) as the extraction model. Firecrawl being open source and self-hostable is a different capability from swapping the LLM backend, and the community comment only suggests adding Ollama support as a request, which is not affirmative evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug in a local or self-hosted LLM as the extraction backend instead of a cloud-only model
